meta.triageRationale: One localized edit with no design choice left: the user decided the behaviour (a chevron on a long assistant response, starting expanded).

body.focus: In the VS Code dev chat, let the user collapse a long assistant response by hand. Since ISSUE-b1c7c1bc (commit 0d000665) the assistant row skips the collapse wrapper entirely, so it has no chevron. A long assistant response (the same test as for a user message: more than 3 lines or more than 240 characters) should get the chevron and start EXPANDED; it must never start collapsed. Short responses stay unwrapped. One function in vscode-plugin/src/chat/render-registry.ts (msgRow) and its tests.
body.summary: A long assistant response (more than 3 lines or 240 characters) now has the collapse chevron and starts expanded, so the user can fold it by hand; it is never folded for them. Short responses are unwrapped as before.
